definition: אֵ֫שֶׁל noun masculine tamarisk-tree (Arabic , Sabean אתֿל SabDenkm 65 compare DHM BS ii. 958 ; on an Aramaic אַתְלָא see Löw No. 38 ; compare Tristr FFP 250 ) planted by Abraham Gen 21:33 ( J ); in 1Sam 22:6 Saul is dwelling בַּגִּבְעָה תַּחַתהָֿאֵשֶׁל בָּרָמָה ; 1Sam 31:13 Saul and his sons are buried ׳ תַּחַתהָֿא ; it was perhaps a sacred tree, marking shrine.
